A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

ginseng tetracylic and oleanane-type triterpenoid derivatives, which were obtained from ginseng and other plants, have cancer preventing activities and that the structure of the active compounds is closely related to the structure of the aglycone moiety, not the sugar moiety.
